zh: 每次删除只涉及相邻的一对字符；删掉之后，新出现的相邻关系只可能在被删位置的两侧。
从左到右扫描，用栈保存还没被消掉的字符：新字符与栈顶组成 AB、BA、CD 或 DC 时二者一起消掉，否则把新字符压栈。
栈为空或新字符与栈顶不能配对时压入；能配对时弹出栈顶并丢弃新字符。扫描结束后按栈底到栈顶的顺序拼接输出，结果为空时输出空行。
en: Each deletion involves one adjacent pair; after it, the only new adjacency appears between the two sides of the deleted spot.
Scan from left to right and keep the characters not yet removed on a stack: if the new character forms AB, BA, CD, or DC with the top, remove both; otherwise push the new character.

Push when the stack is empty or the new character cannot pair with the top; when it can, pop the top and drop the new character. At the end, print the stack from bottom to top, or an empty line if it is empty.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan from left to right and keep the characters not yet removed on a stack. When the new character forms AB, BA, CD, or DC with the top of the stack, pop the top; otherwise push the new character.

## Proof of correctness

After a prefix is scanned, the stack is one irreducible result of that prefix under the removal rules. After a new character is appended, any newly created adjacent removable pair can only span the new character and the end of the old prefix; if they match, both are removed, otherwise the new character stays. By induction, the final string cannot be transformed further and can be obtained from the original string by valid transformations.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
